_README: Social posting configuration. Platform limits are enforced by scripts/generate-social.mjs so a post can never be generated that the API would reject. `enabled` controls what the generator emits; set a platform false to stop producing content for it.

facebook.api: Meta Graph API - Page feed. NOTE: Facebook GROUPS cannot be posted to by any third-party app; Meta removed that permission in 2020. Group posting is manual, permanently.

instagram.api: Instagram Content Publishing API. Requires an Instagram Business/Creator account linked to a Facebook Page, and app review for instagram_content_publish. Media must be reachable at a public URL - the API fetches it, you cannot upload bytes directly.

tiktok.api: TikTok Content Posting API. Un-audited apps can only push to drafts (inbox); publishing directly needs the audited video.publish scope.

whatsapp.api: DISABLED. WhatsApp Status has no API. The WhatsApp Business Platform sends template messages to contacts who opted in - that is re-engagement of existing leads, not broadcast reach, and marketing templates require category approval plus prior opt-in. Do not treat this as a distribution channel.
